title: From Target Selection to Condition Reuse: Auditing Residual Interventions in Tool-Use Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.31686v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Activation interventions can make a language model produce a target answer, but can the model use the intended condition in other computations? We study this question in Qwen3.5-27B on tool-use tasks where time or permissions determine eligibility and selection. Across 32 fresh worlds, two case-specific residual-writing variants raise familiar target-selection correctness from 35/128 to 119/128 and from 33/128 to 114/128. Yet these gains disappear when familiar facts and identifiers are recombined within the same selection task, while selection of previously rewarded identifiers increases. The gains persist across output formats but yield little improvement in independent judgments about whether a candidate is eligible or should be selected. translated_title: 从目标选择到条件复用：审计工具使用模型中的残差干预
translated_abstract: 激活干预可以使语言模型产生目标答案，但模型能否在其他计算中使用所预期的条件？我们在Qwen3.5-27B上研究了这一问题，任务为工具使用场景，其中时间或权限决定候选者的资格与选择。在32个新构建的世界中，两种针对具体案例的残差写入变体将熟悉目标选择的正确率从35/128提升至119/128，以及从33/128提升至114/128。然而，当熟悉的事实和标识符在同一个选择任务中被重新组合时，这些增益便消失了，同时先前被奖励过的标识符被选中的比例反而上升。这些增益在不同输出格式下保持稳定，但在关于候选者是否符合资格或应否被选中的独立判断上几乎没有改善。尽管如此，内部编辑仍能够改变源事实对判断的影响方式：在一项预先设定的次要比较中，当某个源事实被使用时，早期层的源补丁改变了64个判断中的50个……
tldr: 激活干预虽能大幅提升模型对熟悉目标的选择正确率，但这种增益无法泛化到事实与标识符的重新组合或独立资格判断上，仅能改变源事实影响判断的方式。
en_tdlr: Activation interventions dramatically improve a model's selection of familiar targets, but these gains fail to generalize to recombinations of facts and identifiers or independent eligibility judgments, only altering how a source fact influences downstream decisions.
